resources.resource: Enough people to move each assigned item without dragging it or lifting alone

step.action: Ask the Sound Lead which DJ gear to move from the equipment truck.
Move each assigned item to the position given by the Sound Lead.
Put unattended personal belongings from the stage in 🍷 Lost_and_Found.
Return camp equipment not assigned to the event to its storage place.
Put trash from the stage and dance floor in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Put all remaining visible MOOP from 🌐 Event_Stage and 🌐 Dance_Floor in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Observe the running and timestamp indicators on 🌐 DJ_Recorder.
step.ifThen: IF either indicator is missing, THEN tell the Sound Lead before the event starts.

passWhen.criterion: Every item assigned by the Sound Lead is in its assigned position.
Only event equipment remains on the stage.
No unattended belonging, trash, or visible MOOP remains on the stage or dance floor.
The DJ recorder shows that recording and timestamps are active.
